prompt: Create an original 90 second lo-fi instrumental hip hop instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: Rhodes piano, muted drums, warm bass. Style: laid-back swung beat and hazy jazz harmony. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A gentle and reflective instrumental piece featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by pizzicato and sustained strings, and subtle percussion. The mood is calm and slightly melancholic.
description.zh: 一首温柔而富有反思性的器乐作品，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，辅以拨弦和持续的弦乐，以及微妙的打击乐。情绪平静略带忧郁。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
